newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian silver extends losses on large imports.
newsitem.headline: Indian silver extends losses on large imports.

text.p: Silver prices opened lower on Friday and fell further towards the close on large arrivals of about 2,500 kg of imported metal, dealer said.
Silver was down by 60 rupees per kg on Thursday. Poor industrial buying dragged prices downward, dealers said.
Gold opened lower tracking a weak trend in the world market but held steady at the opening level during the day amid sluggish physical enquiries and scattered inflow, they said.
Gold biscuits (116.50 gramme) settled 200 rupees lower at 58,500 rupees per piece.
They were down by 400 rupees on Thursday.
